attchmntText: Eastern Silk Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Eastern Silk Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Statutory Auditors M/s Vyas and Vyas issued a Limited Review Report with an unmodified opinion. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 1,500.23 lakhs compared to 1,174.06 lakhs in the previous year. The company reported a net loss of 1.64 lakhs for the half year, compared to a net loss of 52.00 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 757.36 lakhs. The company reported a net profit of 78.38 lakhs for the quarter, compared to a net loss of 33.50 lakhs in the previous year. Total assets stood at 13,489.12 lakhs as at September 30, 2026.
